title: Disappointing and smaller than expected!
text: Disappointing and smaller than expected!. I purchased this for my daughter who loves all things Nightmare Before Christmas; however, I've ended up returning it prior to gifting. It's quite a bit smaller than I realized. That may be my fault in not checking measurements. It's about the size of a bath towel. In addition, the quality is quite disappointing. I don't like the feel of it. It's almost rough and unpleasant to the touch. The colors are not vibrant the way I'd expected. It's almost like they ran out of color while infusing. Some of the issue might be because I ordered it from the Amazon warehouse which means  items have been returned previously was far as I can tell. They are usually listed as "used." In the case of this blanket, there was a very odd smell to it, almost chemical or sour. But I'm wondering if that is due to someone washing it prior to returning it, and not drying it out well before packing it back up. That's only a guess as I really don't know. But I do know that it's disappointing and I've chosen to return it.
